audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the page's own whys — the chart handed Ornn levels 2, 3 and the first-item stage while whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] all describe Illaoi out-sustaining you at exactly those stages.
audit.why: Packet chart is Ornn / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill / Illaoi / Skill, and every content why matches it row for row. The mirror (illaoi__ornn) flipped the same six rows as matched pairs.
audit.corrected: All six rows flipped as one atomic group across both layers; ratings set to 6,5,4,4,5,4,5 from your side.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' — sequencingCues is 0. Every line said 'when it is down' with no number attached.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s, Harsh Lesson a 4s leap, Tentacle Smash 10s at rank 1, Leap of Faith 120/95/70s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[2].why, phases[5].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions absent. Volcanic Rupture grounds Harsh Lesson — her leap is both her engage and her way off your pillar. Harsh Lesson is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell. And Test of Spirit's spirit echoes a share of the damage it takes back onto you, which is why standing next to it loses the trade.
audit.why: Illaoi W carries dash and autoReset flags; Ornn Q carries grounding. Riot's E text: 'Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target.' All flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.corrected: Grounding written into report[5].t; the echo into dosFull[0].d; the auto reset into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] credits her sustain to 'E sustain'. Test of Spirit has no heal.
audit.why: The healing is Prophet of an Elder God: tentacles 'will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion'.
audit.corrected: whys[3] re-attributed to the tentacle heal.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Illaoi's Test of Spirit is down.
edits.after: A wash — she has one tentacle, you have Bellows Breath but no combo, so neither of you commits yet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Illaoi must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Her tentacle field and Test of Spirit (16s) out-sustain your poke if you stand in it — farm from outside the tentacles.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Test of Spirit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her second tentacle and the passive's heal grind you down in any extended trade — bait Harsh Lesson, then drag her off the field.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Test of Spirit's cooldown.
edits.after: Her first item plus stacked tentacles win any extended fight — only commit off the field, on Test of Spirit.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Her vessel pull. Sidestep it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: 16s at rank 1, 12s maxed — sidestep it or the spirit echoes your damage back. - Harsh Lesson: 4s leap and an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell. - Leap of Faith: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Her vessel pull. Sidestep it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1. The spirit echoes damage to you — kill it or leave.

edits.before: Track Illaoi's Test of Spirit: Her vessel pull. Sidestep it. When it is down — W-E + R her.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture grounds Harsh Lesson — her 4s leap is also her escape from your pillar.

edits.before: Her second tentacle and E sustain mean extended trades in her field grind you down all-lane.
edits.after: Her second tentacle heals her every time it lands, so extended trades in her field grind you down.

notes: Two things worth a manual look. First, Prophet of an Elder God spawns tentacles on nearby impassible terrain — Volcanic Rupture plants a magma pillar, which is terrain. If the pillar can host her tentacles, Ornn's own setup ability feeds her passive, which would reverse the advice in wants.you[1]. Riot's text does not say whether player-created terrain counts, so nothing was written. Second, Leap of Faith carries a grounding flag in the kit file while Riot's description mentions only damage and tentacle spawning; per the run rules I trusted the description and did not assert the grounding, though missingInteractions claims it denies Call of the Forge God. Several full-layer fields still call Illaoi 'him/his' (breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, report[8], report[12]).
